sections.heading: Match Details
paragraphs: The upcoming match between San Miguel and Converge is a significant event in the PBA, as both teams are eager to end their recent losing streaks. According to PBA, 'San Miguel, Converge seek to end skids in second-round opener'.

sections.heading: Current Streaks
